summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for metrics recording using StandardMetrics and MetricsRecorder. It does not semantically match existing skills: the APM skill focuses on LocalStreamEnvironment/Flink setup (unrelated domain), Spring Boot migration is a different task_family (software_migration vs instrumentation), and peer candidates address agent lifecycle, trace initialization, and pytest fixtures—none of which overlap with metrics recording. The candidate has support evidence and no conflicts, warranting creation as a new capability.
